items.title: Ruthie Foster interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 28, 2023
items.q: I had a chance to sit with both of them at different times

ctx.x: Speaking of that if you watch the morning news daily do you wonder about the state of human nature in the last five or six, seven years?

I do. Especially having a child in this world too. Yeah I do. And I try to remember what my place is through music and what I can do to do my part in keeping — if anything, keeping spirits up, keeping spirits on the up. That’s important for me. Yeah. It’s been interesting watching this as a humankind and how we’re treating each other. But I think it was Pete Seeger that really opened my eyes to, it was Pete and Odetta — I had a chance to sit with both of them at different times — that reminded me that we have —…
That’s an excellent coda to our session here. Well this has just been a joy for me, thank you for the joy in the morning as you said, and the afternoon and evening.
